Home News Arts and Culture Business Sports Opinion Research Live TV/Radio Media Elections Dark Mode Dark mode --> Music Prophet Joseph Atarah releases new gospel single, ‘Formula’ Source : Joy Entertainment 13 November 2026 5:31pm ▶ Listen to this article Audio By Carbonatix
Ghanaian gospel musician Prophet Joseph Atarah has released his latest single, Formula , urging believers to remain steadfast in their faith regardless of their circumstances.
The song was produced by Dan Bassey, while its music video was directed and shot by Skyweb.
Speaking about the message behind the song, Prophet Atarah, leader of Believers Grace Crown Ministry International, said life’s circumstances could sometimes make people question God’s plan for their lives.
He said, however, that in God’s own time, He makes all things beautiful, often beyond human imagination.
“You can’t copy someone else’s prayer, someone else’s fasting, someone else’s giving, someone else’s timeline, and expect the same result. What worked for them was for them,” he added.
Prophet Atarah noted that God deals with each person individually, knowing their story, struggles, timing and heart.
“Sometimes He blesses you through hard work. Sometimes through a closed door. Sometimes through waiting. Sometimes through a person you least expected. Sometimes He blesses you when you did everything right. Sometimes He blesses you even when you did everything wrong, just because of grace,” he said.
He urged believers not to compare their journeys with those of others, stressing that God’s blessings do not follow any formula and are often unpredictable.
“His plan for you is not a copy of another man’s plan. It is tailor-made. And when it comes, it will make sense why it didn’t come earlier, why it didn’t come like theirs, and why it had to come like this,” he said.
